display_name: 单源接收机跨日期多分支物理感知半监督研究
scope: Previously exposed development setting source_rx_1 / m1-natural only; seeds 2026092701, 2026092702 and 2026092703; Main split excluded. Source receiver 1 and source days 1, 2, 3; L_s 1260, hidden U_s 11340, V 5400. No target/query training.
initialization: Exact m1-natural same-seed source-only original Tri E20, same six-class model and sample roles; own E10 and E20, fixed E50/11100 updates; no target-based checkpoint selection.
evaluation: Both fixed arms and all three seeds, all predictions frozen before independent truth-last scoring; clean and six practical scenes, each m1-natural same-packet matched controls. Primary DURA-LU, secondary DURA-L and raw. Report per-seed, per-scene, TX/RX/day and paired corrections/regressions. No leo_weak; no test-driven checkpoint choice, candidate tuning, or selective reruns.
success: Aim for greater than 2 percentage points over ordinary PL in each of clean and six practical DURA-LU scene means, and improvement over original Tri. Report each seed separately. A positive result on source_rx_1 cannot establish improvement on other splits; later independent settings and paired seeds are required.
expected_artifacts: Six real-E20 no-query smoke checks with nonzero cross-day relations
Six own E30/E50 checkpoints and recorded cross-day/physical counters
Independent same-packet, three-seed and subgroup truth-last comparisons
